{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats will fight to end institutional and systemic racism in society.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will challenge and dismantle structures that define lasting racial, economic, political, and social inequity.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will promote racial justice through fair, just, and equitable governing of all public-serving institutions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will promote racial justice in the formation of public policy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support removing the Confederate battle flag from public properties.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Confederate battle flag is a symbol of the nation's racist past that has no place in the present or future.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will push for a societal transformation to make it clear that black lives matter.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"There is no place for racism in the country.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The median wealth for African Americans and Latino Americans is roughly one-tenth that of white Americans.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Racial and ethnic disparities in wealth and income are a problem in America.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Wealth and income disparities are stark for American Indians and certain Asian American subgroups.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Wealth and income disparities may become more significant when considering age, disability status, sexual orientation, or gender identity.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
